hook: Swollen Feet and Ankles, Pain or Discomfort? Make sure to clear out all of your symptoms!
claim: Flush Factor Plus is a once-a-day capsule sold for swollen feet and ankles. The seller says it supports healthy fluid circulation in the legs and the body's natural ability to regulate fluids.
ing_note: These ingredients are in a 'proprietary blend' with no amounts. L-citrulline is listed as L-citrulline DL-malate.
use: One capsule a day with plenty of water, according to the website.
price_note: Flush Factor Plus is sold as 2 bottles, 2+1 bottles or 3+3 bottles (free shipping on the larger packages); totals are shown on the order page.
bonuses: Total Freedom: Unlock Painless Movement in Your Lower Body
A second bonus guide on skin care
checks: Swollen ankles can be a sign of heart failure, kidney or liver disease, blood clots or medication side effects, so they need a medical check.
Hibiscus tea modestly lowers blood pressure in trials and has a mild diuretic effect.
Beetroot and citrulline support nitric oxide and blood flow, but there's no evidence they reduce leg swelling.
Pineapple provides bromelain, which has small studies for post-surgery swelling, at doses a blend is unlikely to reach.
cons: Could delay diagnosis of a serious cause of swelling
verdict: Flush Factor Plus uses circulation-themed ingredients, but none has been shown to reduce swollen feet or ankles. New or one-sided swelling, or swelling with breathlessness, needs prompt medical attention. For mild swelling, raising your legs, walking, compression stockings and less salt are proven first steps.
